notes.title: Abibass Trainers Update
notes.content:
Experience the new Abibass trainers!

Gameplay tweaks: some players didn't know they had a map so I've put a little reminder in. Also, I've made it easier to drag legendary keys into their legendary keyholes, the dragged detection area seemed to be too small previously.

Also, I put in a couple of hints to the legendary tasks that were a little too obtuse.

Improvements to performance too. The game may take a little longer to load up, but this should cause less stuttering(caused by loading) during gameplay.

If you experience any technical problems with the game please let me know at:  	rabbitholegames.contact@gmail.com

Thanks!
Joel
